Comments: That day, at 500 mb, the temperature field was in phase with the height field, indicating the presence of a cold trough. No cold front was detected over the Chilean region in the vertical cross-sections made. However, it was found that the disturbance that crossed the Chilean area on the 18th, embedded within a polar air mass, had the essential characteristics of an upper-level cyclone. The instability inherent in the polar air caused by heat transfer from the sea during its oceanic trajectory was increased by the passage of this cold depression at altitude to the point of producing tornadoes
